notes.title: Commencement and Commitment
notes.notes:
[b]There is no doubt that we believe that eggboy will become a big star, not only in the field of games, but also in fields such as film and television. They will bring fun and joy to every family,

As for the developer team, we created and produced this title with great enthusiasm. In the future, we will continue to optimize our works. I hope this work can become a classic.

There is no doubt that the optimization of the multiplayer part will be a top priority in the future, and 2v2 and 5v5 parts will be added at the same time.

New levels will also be added in the single player part. We attach great importance to player experience.

Because every step we take we need the continued support and encouragement of friends who like eggboy.

We look forward to your feedback, your feedback will make this work even better.[/b]
